defects.trigger: aprod = @(mode, m, n, x) lsqraprod(mode, m, n, x, 0, 0); [x, istop, itn, r1norm] = lsqr(4, 3, aprod, zeros(4, 1), 0, 1e-12, 1e-12, 1e8, 10, 0)
defects.observed: 'Output argument "r1norm" (and possibly others) not assigned a value in the execution with "lsqr" function.' - early return on line 143 (arnorm = 0) before lines 147-148; also for A = [1 0; 0 2; 0 0], b = [0; 0; 5]; with <= 3 outputs x = 0, istop = 0
defects.expected: x = 0 with r1norm = norm(b), r2norm = r1norm (OUTPUTS)

defects.title: The x = 0 message is printed even when show = 0

notes: Tests the TOOLBOX lsqr: which('-all','lsqr') lists src/analysis/subspaces/lsqr/lsqr.m first, before toolbox/matlab/sparfun/lsqr.m (stated in the header Purpose). Repro (MATLAB, after initCobraToolbox(false)): aprod = @(mode, m, n, x) lsqraprod(mode, m, n, x, 0, 0); [x, istop, itn, r1norm] = lsqr(4, 3, aprod, zeros(4, 1), 0, 1e-12, 1e-12, 1e8, 10, 0)  % -> Output argument "r1norm" ... not assigned. Same bug in Saunders' original LSQR (pre-2006 versions). Caller lsqrtest (has testLsqrtest.m) uses b = A*xtrue with full-column-rank A, so A'*b ~= 0: it does not reach the defect. Side observations (not recorded as defects): wantvar = nargout >= 6 (line 100) although var is output 10 (only extra work); lsqrtest names output 6/7 xnorm/var although they are anorm/acond. A working LS run was probed: A = [1 0; 0 2; 0 0], b = [1; 2; 3] -> x = [1; 1], istop 2, r1norm 3, var = [1; 0.25].
confirmed_by: lead (source read consistent with the writer's MATLAB reproduction: r1norm is not assigned on the early return for A'b = 0 when 4 or more outputs are requested)
